history_source_assessment.reason: Both concern unsafe path-derived filesystem side effects, but clone abort ownership and recursive deletion differs from assignment validation before directory creation. The target API has no abort or recursive-removal operation.
history_source_assessment.adoptable_transfer: Current-diff containment checks can inspect filesystem side effects in owned temporary directories.
history_source_assessment.rejected_transfer: Clone abort, deletion ownership tracking, git processes and new cleanup abstractions.
